[SWS_TcpIp_00111] ⌈The service TcpIp_Bind() shall bind the socket specified by
parameter SocketId to the local resource specified by parameters LocalAddrId
and PortPtr.⌋
Note: Sockets that shall be switched in a listening state later on must be bound to a
local resource. Optionally this API can be used to specify the local IP address and port
used by later calls of TcpIp_TcpConnect() or TcpIp_UdpTransmit().
